rows.ARS:
Pink blend, medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MACsatur
Exhibition name: Penthouse
rows.Origin: Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1975).
rows.Bloom: Pink. [Pink blend.] Rose pink with yellow tones at center. Mild, moderate fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Large, matte, medium green, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: up to 39" (up to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Notes: Although West Coast (code name Macnauru) is also referred to as Penthouse, Penthouse (code name Macsatur) and West Coast are not the same rose.

colour: Pink. [Pink blend.] Rose pink with yellow tones at center.
